name: US boiler and pressure vessel inspection requirements by state
description: State-by-state comparison of boiler and pressure vessel inspection requirements across all US states. Each record is one state with its inspection intervals by boiler type (power, low-pressure steam, hot water, unfired pressure vessel), accepted inspector qualifications (state, insurance, owner-user), residential and size/pressure exemptions, governing statute citation, and administering agency. Answers 'how often does Ohio require boiler inspections', 'which states accept insurance company inspections in lieu of state inspections', and 'are residential boilers exempt in my state'.
licence: Facts extracted from state statutes (government works) and industry reference (National Board Synopsis, freely published). Inspection intervals and exemptions are regulatory facts, not copyrightable.

records.source_quote: High-pressure boilers: One annual internal certificate inspection; One annual external inspection, in operation, approximately six months from the certificate inspection. Low pressure steam heating boilers located in schoolhouses: one annual certificate inspection, which shall be an internal inspection every third year, with an external or internal inspection at the discretion of the inspector on the two intervening years. Low pressure hot-water supply boilers located in schoolhouses: one annual certificate inspection, which shall be an internal inspection where possible, every third year, with an external or internal inspection at the discretion of the inspector during the two intervening years. Low pressure hot-water heating boilers located in schoolhouses: one annual certificate inspection, which shall be an internal inspection every third year, with an external inspection during the two intervening years. Pressure vessels: Initial inspection shall be an external safety inspection; Renewal certificate inspections are completed once every 3 years and it shall be an internal where construction permits. records.source_quote: Division of Industry Services administers inspections under Wisconsin Administrative Code, SPS Chapter 341. Authorized inspector types: Wisconsin accepts insurance company inspectors and owner inspectors who hold Certificates of Competency issued by the department. Inspection frequency: High-pressure boilers require annual internal inspections, with external inspections accepted where internal access is not possible. Low-pressure boilers require external or internal inspections every 36 months.

also_reported.value: one external or internal inspection every 36 months
also_reported.source_quote: One annual internal inspection. Where an internal inspection is not possible because of boiler construction, an external inspection will be acceptable. Should operating conditions require longer periods, an extension of time may be granted upon written application to the department with written concurrence of inspection agency. Low-pressure steam and hot-water boilers: one external or internal inspection every 36 months. Pressure vessels: one external or internal inspection every 36 months. Anhydrous ammonia storage and nurse tanks: one inspection every 36 months. Power piping: welder documentation and material inspection prior to start of fabrication (installed to ASME B31.1). INSURANCE INSPECTION REQUIREMENTS The department must be notified of suspension of insurance because of dangerous conditions . The department must be notified of new business or discontinuance of insurance . CERTIFICATE OF INSPECTION Certificate of Inspection is issued by the State of Wisconsin.
